notes.title: UPDATE: SEASON1 Is Live
notes.content:
Dear Puzzlers,

after a lengthy design phase it has finally arrived.
We are happy to announce our first update that has just went live with 20 brand new levels.

The levels are not restricted or locked. They can be freely played without requirements on completing the base game. Completing all 20 levels will grant you the SEASON1 Completed achievement.

In the future we plan to release smaller updates more frequently so you don't have to wait like two months for the new content.

Enjoy the new challenges and have fun.
Tell your friends about it so they won't miss the fun.
Want to be updated? Don't forget to follow us on steam and on social media.

notes.title: DevBlog: upcoming game update
notes.content:
Dear Puzzlers,

as promised, we're working hard to deliver our first major update for EXIT at absolutely no extra cost for you.
Expected release date is in the first half of February.

Like in the base game you'll get carefully handcrafted puzzles, however, this time we're raising the bar even more.
Over twenty brand new challenging levels waiting to be solved.

The new season will need to be unlocked by completing the base game with a high score.

Actually, we recommend playing the base game over a few times before this update goes live.

notes.title: EXIT is available
notes.content:
We happily announce a full game release.
We wish many hours of exciting gameplay to all of you.

Don't forget to tell about this game to your friends. They deserve some thrill too. :)

Don't hesitate to share your favorite screenshots on our community hub.
You also may consider publishing your gameplay videos showing off your best wins or the most thrilling moments in the game.

notes.title: Launch date and features
notes.content:
EXIT launches on 16th, Dec 2016.
EXIT DEMO will be made available on steam one week earlier on 9th, Dec 2016.


We introduced difficulty levels allowing to play with no time pressure.

The following steam features will come with the full version:

Cloud saves
Achievements
Trading cards
